name: auditEvents
sql: CREATE TABLE "auditEvents" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "occurredAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "requestID" TEXT NOT NULL, "mcpRequestID" TEXT, "invocationID" TEXT, "parentRequestID" TEXT, "ticketID" TEXT, "caller" TEXT NOT NULL, "transport" TEXT, "socketConnectionID" TEXT, "tunnelInstanceID" TEXT, "tunnelProfileID" TEXT, "profileID" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspaceID" TEXT, "capabilityID" TEXT NOT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL, "errorCode" TEXT, "durationMilliseconds" INTEGER, "inputDigest" TEXT, "outputDigest" TEXT, "outputByteCount" INTEGER, "outputTruncated" BOOLEAN, "principalDigest" TEXT)

name: auditEvents_on_invocationID
sql: CREATE INDEX "auditEvents_on_invocationID" ON "auditEvents"("invocationID")

name: auditEvents_on_mcpRequestID
sql: CREATE INDEX "auditEvents_on_mcpRequestID" ON "auditEvents"("mcpRequestID")

name: auditEvents_on_occurredAt
sql: CREATE INDEX "auditEvents_on_occurredAt" ON "auditEvents"("occurredAt")

name: auditEvents_on_socketConnectionID

name: auditEvents_on_ticketID
sql: CREATE INDEX "auditEvents_on_ticketID" ON "auditEvents"("ticketID")

name: auditEvents_on_tunnelInstanceID

name: auditEvents_on_verified_scope
sql: CREATE INDEX "auditEvents_on_verified_scope" ON "auditEvents"("principalDigest", "profileID", "workspaceID", "occurredAt")

name: clientControlTrust

name: configurationRevisions
sql: CREATE TABLE "configurationRevisions" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "manifest" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "activatedAt" DATETIME, "activationError" TEXT)

name: grdb_migrations
sql: CREATE TABLE grdb_migrations (identifier TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

name: mcpExecutions

sql: CREATE INDEX "mcpExecutions_on_outputExpiresAt" ON "mcpExecutions"("outputExpiresAt")

name: operationTickets
sql: CREATE TABLE "operationTickets" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "capabilityID" TEXT NOT NULL, "caller" TEXT NOT NULL, "profileID" TEXT NOT NULL, "principalID" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspaceID" TEXT, "inputDigest" TEXT NOT NULL, "stateDigest" TEXT, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "prepareRequestID" TEXT NOT NULL, "invocationID" TEXT, "parentRequestID" TEXT, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "expiresAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "executingAt" DATETIME, "completedAt" DATETIME, "failureCode" TEXT, "authorizationRevision" INTEGER, "reviewSummary" TEXT, "controlSessionID" TEXT, "controlSessionRevision" INTEGER, "reviewTitle" TEXT)

name: pluginDerivedWorkspaces
sql: CREATE TABLE "pluginDerivedWorkspaces" ("workspaceID" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "sourceWorkspaceID" TEXT NOT NULL, "receiptID" TEXT NOT NULL, "payloadJSON" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("origin", "sourceWorkspaceID", "receiptID"))

name: pluginOwnedDirectories

name: pluginState
sql: CREATE TABLE "pluginState" ("id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payloadJSON" TEXT NOT NULL)

name: profiles
sql: CREATE TABLE "profiles" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "capabilityIDsJSON" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspaceIDsJSON" TEXT NOT NULL, "allowedCallersJSON" TEXT NOT NULL, "fullShellEnabled" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "mcpServerIDsJSON" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "mode" TEXT, "confirmationPolicy" TEXT, "authorizationRevision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: providerStates
sql: CREATE TABLE "providerStates" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "executablePath" TEXT, "observedVersion" TEXT, "health" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT, "checkedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

sql: CREATE TABLE "workspaces" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "displayName" TEXT NOT NULL, "rootPath" TEXT NOT NULL, "bookmarkData" BLOB, "bookmarkIsStale" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)
